title: PGGMB Building
axis: +X follows the longer frontage; +Z toward the near intersection.
source: OpenStreetMap named PGGMB Building footprint and verified owner record
identityStatus: Named five-node OpenStreetMap way 314217096 provides the main external outline and 17 storeys at Jalan Kianggeh. The Brunei Malay Teachers Association independently identifies the address and 17-storey replacement.

terrainContact.basis: Original ground south of the street-facing podium.

notes: The 14 May 2002 official opening confirms continuity of site with the 26 February 1965 original. Mixed floor usage establishes broad retail podium, mid-level parking, and upper office and meeting functions. The modeled exterior articulation and height are estimates.
